decisions.reason: The cited text exists, but the claimed contradiction does not follow. The chapter begins around 05:40; an application due at 08:00 can coherently be submitted at 07:52. When Eli reports that submission at 18:10, 07:52 is correctly in the past. Kade misses the proposed 08:00 check-in while waiting at the terminal, but that is not an impossible application chronology. The closing reference to being present at eight functions as a later commitment callback and does not establish that the submission occurred at 19:52.
